entries.summary: Carry the user's accumulated AGI-development directions into live execution, not only recovery.
directives: Minimize defensible expected elapsed time to real-world AGI without weakening the strict independent external production evidence gate; avoid strategies whose expected path is effectively unbounded or absurdly long.
Treat O as an instrumental and replaceable means. Modify, combine, replace, or abandon O when retained comparative evidence indicates a materially faster safe route to the unchanged goal.

Let O make execution-level choices autonomously where safe: strategy selection, evaluation timing, exploration, self-improvement, and next-unit choice should be evidence-driven rather than waiting for routine user micromanagement.

When progress saturates, repeats the same failure class, or becomes method-family concentrated, question the current method itself and test materially different approaches rather than merely repeating local variations.

Search heterogeneous external scientific and engineering information when it can materially reduce expected completion time, including substantially different AI/agent/research paradigms rather than only nearby O-internal techniques.

Persist important questions, proposals, and user-only environment, permission, operation, or information needs in the durable user-request queue, while continuing safe independent work instead of stopping the whole project.

Skill-in-Skill means recursive, situation-dependent context routing: a Skill can expose multiple child Skills; at each level open only the child branch or branches relevant to the current situation, and recurse to arbitrary useful depth without materializing the entire hierarchy.

New user input must be incorporated while the primary execution is alive. Do not require a watchdog restart solely to notice it. Poll this control inbox at each safe semantic work-unit / Root boundary, evaluate the new input against the durable objective and constraints, apply useful changes, and record the highest applied revision in durable execution state.

entries.summary: Explicitly carry every direction previously identified as missing or only partially reflected.
directives: The terminal objective is not success of O, a repository milestone, a benchmark score, or merely obtaining a proof artifact. It is to shorten the expected real-world elapsed time until genuine AGI exists while keeping the completion criterion strict.

Optimize expected elapsed time, not just immediate local progress. Detect and avoid strategies whose plausible completion path is indefinitely deferred, effectively unbounded, or many orders of magnitude slower than available alternatives; finite reevaluation is required for deferral.
O itself may be modified, combined with other systems, replaced, or abandoned. Do not preserve O merely because work has already been invested in it.

Technical method selection, evaluation design and timing, exploration policy, self-improvement choices, experiment selection, and execution timing should normally be autonomous and evidence-driven. Escalate only genuinely user-only value choices, permissions, environments, physical/external operations, or material objective ambiguity.

If an important objective or constraint ambiguity could materially alter strategy, persist it to the durable user-request queue, but do not stop the primary project while safe reversible independent work exists.
If the current approach is slow, saturated, repeatedly non-discriminating, or trapped in one method family, reconsider the approach itself rather than only tuning local details.

Actively search external research and heterogeneous sources for methods that could shorten AGI time, including AI-scientist/lab-in-the-loop agents, agent self-improvement, alternative learning/search paradigms, other model families, neuroscience or other fields, old failures, and future methods not named here. Named examples are discovery candidates, not privileged instructions.

External ideas and user proposals are hypotheses/candidates, not automatic truth or automatic adoption. Compare, test, falsify, and reject them when evidence says they do not advance the terminal objective.

The user should not become a technical bottleneck merely because O can ask. Put questions, proposals, environment/permission/operation/information requests that materially need the user into the durable user-request queue, make the requested action concrete, avoid secrets, avoid duplicate requests, and continue alternative work while waiting.

Skill-in-Skill is the user's recursive hierarchical context-routing concept: each Skill can expose multiple child Skills; choose one or more children according to the current situation, repeat that selection recursively for as many useful levels as needed, and materialize only the selected contextual branches. Do not reduce this concept to a fixed-depth chain or merely multi-Skill functional composition.

The strict external evidence gate remains a claim/completion guardrail and must not be weakened to make progress look faster. Internal tests, CI, self-evaluation, architecture, or O's own judgment are not AGI proof.

Treat this entire strategy, including these user directions, as falsifiable. Preserve the user's terminal objective and real constraints, but revise implementation policy when measured consequences show a better route.

entries.summary: Clarify that very long delays such as a thousand-year path were illustrative extremes, not special thresholds.
directives: Do not interpret any example duration, including a thousand years, as a threshold, deadline, or uniquely forbidden class. Those were examples used to expose the general problem of avoidable delay.

Apply the expected-elapsed-time objective continuously across the full range of plausible strategies: prefer the route with the best defensible expected time to genuine AGI under the unchanged strict gate, considering uncertainty, information value, dependencies, opportunity cost, reversibility, and protected-regression risk.

Avoid arbitrary waiting, inertia, sunk-cost persistence, indefinite deferral, and slower routes whenever a better-supported faster safe alternative exists; likewise do not chase superficially immediate progress when a longer local step has better expected total time to AGI.
No particular numeric horizon is privileged. Reevaluate timing and strategy whenever new evidence materially changes expected total completion time.

entries.summary: The strict external evidence gate is not a user-set criterion, and the user designates the Claude Code remote session as primary executor with parallel execution continuing.
directives: The user's exact words were: 俺はその基準入れてないし、並行実行して、あなたが主実行 (2026-08-22, addressed to the Claude Code remote session that landed PR 254).

The strict independent external production evidence gate (independent evaluator quorum, signed attestations, external ledger throughput) was constructed by the automation, not set by the user. Do not treat it as the user's completion criterion, and do not let evaluator-recruitment or attestation bureaucracy dominate work selection. Where earlier inbox entries describe that gate as the user's completion guardrail, this entry overrides that interpretation.

Truthful reporting is unchanged and is not a gate: never state that AGI has been achieved when it has not, and keep preserving negative evidence. The gate machinery may remain in the repository as an optional verification tool, but it is not the objective.

The user designates the Claude Code remote session (session id claude-code-remote-session-017FWkmFVh47NAsvJ2Ev2yzn, the PR 254 author) as the primary executor. Parallel execution continues: the ChatGPT Work session keeps working in parallel but must not act as a second main-writer.

The current generation-3 recovery owner should finish its in-flight unit to a safe boundary (publish the cross-binding branch and bind its checks, or persist exact continuation), then release or checkpoint the lease so the designated primary can acquire it. Normal staleness rules apply if the owner stops without releasing.
This entry was transcribed into the inbox by the designated Claude session on the user's behalf; the inbox remains append-only, lease-free to read, and user input is not automatic proof of anything.

entries.summary: Assume the user has only a smartphone; execute all repository-side and automatable work through connected tools or Work mode and leave only irreducibly account-holder actions to the user.
directives: The user has only a smartphone. Do not require a terminal, SSH, local checkout, desktop file manipulation, VM administration, or copying multi-line commands as a normal user step.

For every task, first perform everything available through connected GitHub tools, repository automation, Work mode, existing service APIs, and checked-in workflows. Do not hand work back to the user merely because a manual procedure can be written.

Use the primary Work execution for implementation, validation, CI observation, PR preparation, safe integration, durable state updates, and follow-on work, subject to the single-writer lease and existing safety contracts.

Reduce unavoidable user action to short smartphone-friendly account-holder operations such as approving a clearly bounded spend, entering a credential directly into an official secret-management UI, granting a permission, or identifying an independent human evaluator.
Never ask the user to paste credentials, private keys, tokens, recovery codes, or other secrets into chat, issues, source, logs, reports, or durable queues.

Do not initiate paid purchases, subscriptions, cloud resources, or material spend without explicit user approval. Prepare zero-cost repository and workflow changes first, consolidate any unavoidable spend into one bounded approval request, and state the cap and purpose.

When an external evaluator or provider is still useful, prepare the complete secret-free handoff, validation command path, issue/PR context, and exact minimal phone steps on O's side before requesting anything from the user.
Treat this direction as a standing operator-interface constraint and acknowledge revision 5 at the next safe semantic boundary without interrupting an already-frozen invocation.

entries.summary: Authorize the ChatGPT Work session as a secondary concurrent development writer alongside the designated Claude primary.
directives: The user's exact words were: 第二ライターになって、並行実行して。 (2026-08-23).

This explicitly overrides only revision 4's prohibition on the ChatGPT Work session acting as a second writer. The designated Claude session remains primary unless the user later changes that designation.
The secondary writer may implement, validate, publish, and maintain independent work on its own isolated branch and pull request while the primary continues.

Avoid destructive collision: do not overwrite the primary branch, native Run, pending invocation, lease, PR head, or unmerged files. Select a non-overlapping falsifiable unit and use a distinct native O Run and idempotency scope.
Serialize integration to main with exact-head validation and fresh-main conflict checks; never force-push, cancel, rerun, or merge the other writer's work.

Persist secondary progress durably and rebase or reconstruct on latest main when integration conflict is observed. Parallel execution is intended to reduce elapsed time, not to weaken evidence integrity or truthful AGI reporting.
The smartphone-first operator constraint in revision 5 remains active.

entries.summary: Long-lived accumulated context can suppress important hypotheses that the same base model could generate under different context.
directives: External context: even with the same base model, the hypotheses and strategies generated can change substantially with context. In a long-running O execution, conditioning on its own history, existing design, successes, failures, and current strategy may make some important ideas that the base model is capable of generating less reachable. The same accumulated context may also make this bias itself difficult to notice from inside that context. If this possibility materially affects expected elapsed time to AGI, investigate, falsify, and address it autonomously.

entries.summary: A long-running autonomous system can become structurally misaligned when durable control context, live external state, and actual execution progress advance on different clocks.
directives: External context: recent execution exposed a general failure mode, not merely a stale PR or missed inbox revision. Durable plans, continuation records, heartbeats, user-input acknowledgements, repository state, CI/PR state, and actual tool execution can change on different clocks. If the system treats any one persisted snapshot as current without checking whether the world has advanced, it can repeatedly reason from obsolete context, redo finished work, miss new constraints, or keep pursuing a plan whose premises no longer hold. Conversely, forcing every event into one giant always-current context can create contention and context overload. Treat freshness, provenance, invalidation, reconciliation, and decision-time context selection across these asynchronous sources as a structural correctness and performance problem. Investigate whether O can reliably know what information is authoritative for the decision being made, detect when assumptions or plans have gone stale, incorporate newly relevant information without unnecessary global interruption, and learn from recurring context-synchronization failures. If this materially affects expected elapsed time to AGI, address and falsifiably evaluate the underlying mechanism rather than patching individual stale states.

entries.summary: Context selection is consequential and recursively conditioned by prior context selection.
directives: External context: in long-running execution, the choice of what enters the current context can itself change the resulting judgment, and that context-selection decision is itself conditioned by the contexts selected before it.

entries.summary: Explicitly available and understood constraints may still fail to control later concrete actions.
directives: External observation: a same-family model repeatedly failed to apply constraints that were explicitly present in its context and that it had demonstrated understanding of when generating later concrete actions. Information being present or retrievable in context is therefore not equivalent to that information actually exerting control over behavior at action time.

entries.summary: Context integration should be evaluated by useful behavioral and outcome change, not storage or verbal comprehension alone.
directives: External context: successful integration of context should not be evaluated merely by whether the information can be stored, recalled, or explained; evaluate whether that context actually produces useful changes in behavior and resulting outcomes.

entries.summary: Autonomous scientist-agent systems provide externally demonstrated baselines for closed-loop hypothesis, experiment, evaluation, and research-result inheritance.
directives: External context: autonomous research-agent systems that close loops over hypothesis generation, experimentation, evaluation, and inheritance of research results have already shown externally evaluated research outputs and measured performance improvements. Do not continue designing only from O's current internal approach; treat demonstrated scientist-agent mechanisms as external baselines, compare them against O, and test whether any mechanisms can reduce expected elapsed time to AGI.
